## About
S & H Automotive is a car repair and maintenance shop on Downey Avenue in Downey. We handle routine service and repairs, and our goal is simple: keep you safe and happy on the road.
We only use parts from reputable brands, and we want every visit to be stress-free, whether you're new to us or coming back. One longtime customer called us family operated, and another said Steve and Henry are honest, reasonable, and hardworking.
Drivers have rated us 4.7 on Google from 76 reviews. If something on your car doesn't feel right, give us a call.

## Services
- Oil change: Conventional oil change up to 5 quarts. Synthetic oil is also available.
- Front brake job: Our front brake job includes a rotor resurface and ceramic pads.
- Inspections and repairs: Bring your car in for a routine inspection or a repair, and we'll take care of it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer synthetic oil changes?
A: Yes. Along with conventional oil changes, synthetic is also available.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: We only use parts from reputable brands so your vehicle is ready to drive.
